new_bugs.user_impact: second engine web-bind crash or duplicate paper-broker sessions

new_bugs.title: updater resume appends FULL body onto prefix when intermediary ignores Range — never converges, misleading SHA-mismatch error
new_bugs.root_cause: download() never checks response status/Content-Range before appending
new_bugs.user_impact: update download fails with wrong error on Range-ignoring proxies; retry loop cannot converge
new_bugs.fails_before: real local HTTP server ignoring Range: 1000-byte .part + full 1500-byte body -> 2500-byte file, hash mismatch (probe verified)
new_bugs.fix_target: detect non-206 (200/416) -> restart hash from zero or clear part; bounded retries preserved

new_bugs.title: `nexus stop` on dead/stale pidfile prints green 'Engine stopped' success even when taskkill rc=128 process-not-found (rc discarded, check=False)
new_bugs.user_impact: misleading success panel; PID-reuse window means wrong-process kill is unreported
new_bugs.evidence: probe: taskkill /PID 4194303 -> rc 128 'not found'; CLI ignores and prints success (test_e2e_29 asserts the misleading behavior)
new_bugs.fix_plan: inspect taskkill result; 'not found' -> report 'engine already stopped (stale pidfile)', still unlink pidfile

new_bugs.title: `nexus update rollback` with no backup -> FAILED_SAFE but exit 0 + human panel 'Rollback: None' (human/JSON disagree)
new_bugs.root_cause: FAILED_SAFE in ok_states of _update_exit_code; human branch prints report['status'] which is absent in rollback reports
new_bugs.user_impact: scripted callers see success; human user sees empty panel on a failed rollback
new_bugs.fails_before: live CLI run: EXIT=0, JSON state=FAILED_SAFE error_code=NO_BACKUP, human panel shows None (reproduced twice)
new_bugs.fix_target: non-zero exit for FAILED_SAFE, warning panel with state+error_message, ROLLED_BACK stays exit 0
